I’m a Senior Data Engineer and AI Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing scalable cloud data platforms, modern Lakehouse architectures, and AI-powered data solutions across Healthcare, FinTech, Analytics, and EdTech. I specialize in Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, and cloud platforms including Azure and AWS, with experience building high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines, real-time data solutions, and enterprise data platforms.

My recent work focuses on Generative AI and AI-ready data engineering, including RAG, LLM applications, AI Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, Azure OpenAI, vector databases, and semantic search. I enjoy working at the intersection of data engineering and AI, building reliable data foundations and intelligent applications that turn complex enterprise data into scalable, production-ready solutions.
